description: Create a `DesignEpoch` that HAS HAPPENED — a point on the time axis you are recording, which is what an epoch has always meant here. NOTE THE STORED TYPE NAME is `DesignEpoch`, not `Epoch`: that is the string `get_node` and `scan_nodes` want. For a point that has NOT happened yet, use plan_epoch instead; planning is a deliberate act and reads better as its own verb than as a flag.
name: add_epoch
